text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After her humiliating defeat in the<n>exhibition race,
Symboli Rudolf no<n>longer believes she deserves to
call<n>herself the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But despite her bitter tears, I gently<n>reassure her
that she was, and still is,<n>worthy. And, as if to
prove it...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She lifts her head to see a crowd of<n>Umamusume.
The students she<n>devoted herself to have turned
out in<n>force to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her fierce will blazes in her eyes<n>once more as
she remembers what it<n>truly means to be the
Emperor.
